A solid weeknight go-to: **One-Pan Lemon-Garlic Chicken with Broccoli & Rice**  
- 20 min active, 25 min total.  
- Pound chicken thighs, season with salt/pepper/paprika, sear 4 min/side in a large skillet.  
- Add minced garlic, lemon zest, splash of broth; nestle broccoli florets around chicken, cover 6 min.  
- Finish with lemon juice, parsley. Serve over microwavable rice.
